name: @estate/service-ai-assistant
description: AI estate assistant (M10): the isolating boundary for model providers (docs/00 feature 6, docs/01 §2.8, TB5). Retrieval is READ-ONLY tool calls over the user's own structured estate data — never a vector store, so nothing is copied into a second index whose access rules could drift from the source's. The service holds NO internal service credential in either direction and reaches its peers only by forwarding the caller's own bearer, so the process with the largest prompt-injection surface in the product can never mint authority it was not handed. Uploaded-document text and OCR output are UNTRUSTED INPUT and are never treated as instructions (docs/03 §4 TB5, risk #6). PR1 shipped the spine — conversation storage, the tool surface, a deterministic stub gateway — with no model call anywhere; PR2 adds the live Anthropic adapter (the only file in the platform that may import the provider SDK, enforced by a source scan) behind a tokenizing privacy proxy that substitutes user-authored identifiers by declared field and restores them before the user or the transcript sees the reply.
